violation_type.title: Center not on probation, suspension, emergency suspension, or revocation in two years preceding or admin penalty (26 TAC §746.1317(a)(6)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Center not on probation, suspension, emergency suspension, or revocation in two years preceding or admin penalty
violation_type.typical_finding: One of our six staff trainings records reviewed has certificates for trainings provided by the Director. The trainings were provided within two years after operation was issued an administrative penalty.

finding_variants.text: One of our six staff trainings records reviewed has certificates for trainings provided by the Director. The trainings were provided within two years after operation was issued an administrative penalty.

The director of this operation has provided current training to staff but the operation has been assesed an administrative penalty within the last two years.  Penalty was assessed on 10/23/2023.  Operation director will not be able to provide training until 10/24/2025.
Transportation training provided to staff who transport children did not meet training criteria as the operation received an administrative penalty in the two years prior to othe training.

Training certificates were reviewed during this inspection and it was determined the director provided trainings to staff members. The operation received an administrative penalty on 10/12/2022, 04/04/2023, and 05/22/2023.
